title: Adrenaline mod
description: this mod gives you adrenaline needle
body:
Hi this is a Adrenaline mod, you can craft adrenaline needle that gives you helth boost, regeneration, strenght, flowing, speed 
### **you will need** **_
```
1 redstone block, 8 redstone dust// 1 gold block, 8 gold_ingots// 6 Ocean ingots
```
_**

**If it asks you that this world uses experimental settings click Yes!!**

Ocean ingors is a new ingot and his ore generates at min y-64 and max y15
